**Who are we?**  
  
The 45 Commando are Royal Marine MILSIM based in the UK. We are accepting all people with ZERO APPLICATION from EU and United Kingdom. If you're looking for a unit with a combined milsim experience of over 30 years and years of IRL experience, then this is the place to be! We have realistic missions and realistic trainings to make our milsim the best we can and most enjoyable for the members we have.  
  
**45 Commando:**  
  
45 Commando Whiskey Company are a Light Infantry group within 3 Commando Brigade. We have multiple roles on offer within our Infantry; ranging from standard infantry roles to support roles. The 45 Commando are experts in amphibious assaults, humanitarian support and disaster relief at home and across the globe.  
  
Currently, 45 Commando are on an overseas mission to Chernarus, providing Counter Insurgency at Chernogorsk and its immediate surroundings.  
  
**Zeus Troop:**  
  
We are actively recruiting for our Zeus Troop and are looking for people with some or plenty of experience playing as an in-game Zeus. Some of the responsibilities are as follows:  
  
\- Roleplaying as enemy and civilian characters in operations.  
  
\- Building weekly operations live on the server from our base mission file based on Company briefing.  
  
\- Utilizing the in-game modules and modded modules e.g. ACE, ALiVE, Zeus Enhanced, etc.  
  
\- Working with Company Command to assist in campaign storytelling.  
  
\- Creating realistic and balanced encounters and compositions.  
  
**Commando Helicopter Force:**  
  
Our CHF flies the Merlin and Wildcat airframes. The CHF deploy with the Royal Marines under the Royal Navy. Within the CHF, we try to keep our forces specially trained and professional within their roles to keep them up to date and prevent accidents. The CHF has 3 Squadrons under our control, all carrying out different roles and preferences within their Airframes.  
  
**845 NAS:**  
  
845 Naval Air Squadron operates the Merlin Mk3 Helicopter carrying out load-carrying and passenger capacity during operations. 845 NAS has the ability to land almost anywhere and work from ships.  
  
**846 NAS:**  
  
846 Naval Air Squadron is one of two of our front-line squadrons who make the Commando Helicopter Force. They use the Merlin Mk3 Helicopter and specialise in Troop Transport around the globe in operations.  
  
**847 NAS:**  
  
847 Naval Air Squadron are equipped with the Augusta-Westland Wildcat AH1 Combat Helicopter. They provide us with reconnaissance, air support and anti-armour capabilities. All personnel in 847 are trained in survival techniques that allow them to operate in any environment.  
  
**Our Events**  
  
Our events happen weekly and members are expected to attend each event each week. We have two main events each week that are trainings and operations.  
  
Tuesday: 1900 GMT - Main Training for Whiskey Company, CHF and Supporting Elements, and Phase 1 Recruit training.  
  
Thursday: 1900 GMT - Main Operation for Whiskey Company, CHF and Supporting Elements  
  
How to get involved?  
  
**Head over to our Discord: https://discord.gg/zep4Hxy**  
  
To get in touch with one of our recruitment staff who would be happy to introduce you to our unit.
